DAYCARE FOR YOUR FAMILY'S DAY

More than
a place to wait.

Your child is cared for, not merely supervised. For working families, Kabira's daycare is designed to feel like an extension of the school day itself, not a holding room until pick-up.

A DAY THAT DOESN'T RUSH

Play, rest
and reassurance.

Daycare runs alongside any of our preschool programmes, giving families a dependable place for their child before and after school hours — with the same warmth and attention as the classroom day.

A daycare afternoon isn't a waiting room. The same teachers, the same calm environment and the same emotional attention carry through from the school day, so a child moves between preschool and daycare without feeling like they've changed worlds.

Where it's useful, daycare time also includes guided learning support — gentle reinforcement of what was covered in class, through conversation and age-appropriate activity rather than formal homework. For a preschool child, staying engaged matters more than finishing a worksheet.

8:30 AM — 6:30 PM

Supervised play
Rest & quiet time
Stories & creativity

A CALM RHYTHM

A few familiar
moments.

Daycare moves at an easier pace than the school day — enough structure to feel secure, enough calm to feel like home.

  1. 01

    Quiet rest time

    A calm space to nap or unwind, especially for younger children.

  2. 02

    Relaxed mealtimes with gentle supervision and conversation.

  3. 03

    Free play

    Toys, games and unstructured time to simply be a child.

  4. 04

8:30 AM — 6:30 PM

One continuous, caring school day — from early arrival through evening pickup. Your work day and your child's day align.

DAYCARE QUESTIONS

A few things
you may ask.

What are the daycare timings? +

Daycare is available from 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM, alongside regular preschool hours of approximately 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM.

Is daycare available for all age groups? +

Daycare can be discussed alongside any of our preschool programmes. Our team can talk through the right arrangement for your family during your enquiry.

Can we use daycare without full-time preschool enrolment? +

Every family's needs are a little different — let us know what you're looking for in your enquiry, and our team will confirm what's possible.
